title: Keep-It Refund Computation for Northgate Marketplace Returns
content:
Refund computation of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee: the keep-it refund.

**Scope and request.** This policy fixes the keep-it refund, the unit refund Northgate books when a seller answers a buyer's return request with a refund without return; the request handled is the return request most recently answered on the order with a refund without return (where two such entries share a date, the one recorded first counts), and the line, the requested units and the reason are the ones that request records. The policy applies only where the order is of a seller program other than Fulfilled by Northgate, was paid with an external card and carries no more than ten lines, the order carries exactly one return request the seller answered with a refund without return, the requested line carries exactly one return request, and the request names at least one unit; elsewhere it fixes nothing, its figure is zero and the base rule stands: "The seller must refund within the program's seller refund time in business days after the return is delivered, the price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most the program's maximum restocking percentage on an opened change-of-mind return, plus the original shipping charge where the program refunds the original shipping on a seller-fault return and the reason is a seller fault and never for a change of mind." A keep-it refund carries no shipping; the original shipping of a seller-fault request is refunded on its own shipping refund under the return rule.

**Quantities.** The requested line's set price per unit is its line amount divided by the units bought on it, and the price paid for the requested units is that set price per unit times the requested units; the units of the requested line kept at the set price are the units bought on it less the units asked back on it by change-of-mind return requests. The return refunds already recorded on the requested line are every return refund entry there. The order's merchandise total is the sum of its line amounts.

**Amount.** The keep-it refund is the listed unit price of the requested line times the requested units, less the return refunds already recorded on the requested line; it never falls below zero, and only that final figure is rounded half up to the cent. The merchandise value of the requested units in the keep-it refund, and every amount taken from the keep-it refund, are settled before the return refunds already recorded on the requested line are subtracted and before the final rounding.

**Hypothetical worked case.** A Northgate Marketplace Certified Renewed order paid by external card: the seller answered a request for 2 units of a line of 2 units listed at USD 120.00 with a refund without return, and no return refund is recorded on the line. The keep-it refund is 120.00 times 2, that is 240.00. Had a return refund of 240.00 already been recorded on the line, the figure would be 240.00 less 240.00, that is 0.00; it never falls below zero.
